title: Confidence reads Low, Medium or High; No data is its own state
custom_preconds:
1. Sign in to the Maintenance Reminders QA build as an Owner/Admin (any user who can open Settings > Maintenance and create and edit work orders and customers).
  2. Open Settings > Maintenance, press New schedule and create a throwaway schedule 'ZZAUTOTEST Reading seed' holding one routine service per reading you will seed, named 'ZZ Seed 1', 'ZZ Seed 2' and so on, each with a Calendar trigger of Every 12 months and no canned lines. Save. (If it already exists, reuse it.)
  3. In Settings > Maintenance create a schedule 'ZZAUTOTEST Rate PM' with one service 'PM-M': a Distance trigger set At 360,000 mileage and a Calendar trigger of Every 12 months. Save.
  4. Create units 'ZZAUTOTEST 560' to 'ZZAUTOTEST 562' as follows: Open Customers > 'ZZAUTOTEST Fleet Co' > Assets and create unit '<unit>' with New Asset, leaving Mileage and Engine Hours empty. On its Maintenance tab press Enroll in Schedule, choose 'ZZAUTOTEST Reading seed' and give every seed service a last service date five years ago (for example 6 Oct 2021), so each seed service reads Overdue and shows on the work order card; press Enroll. Enroll the unit on 'ZZAUTOTEST Rate PM' too, with PM-M last done today.
  5. Readings for 'ZZAUTOTEST 560' (oldest first): 1) 30 days before today (e.g. 6 Sep 2026) · 300,000 mileage; 2) 20 days before today (e.g. 16 Sep 2026) · 301,000 mileage; 3) 10 days before today (e.g. 26 Sep 2026) · 302,000 mileage. (High)
  6. Readings for 'ZZAUTOTEST 561' (oldest first): 1) 20 days before today (e.g. 16 Sep 2026) · 300,000 mileage; 2) 10 days before today (e.g. 26 Sep 2026) · 301,000 mileage. (Medium)
  7. Readings for 'ZZAUTOTEST 562' (oldest first): 1) 70 days before today (e.g. 28 Jul 2026) · 300,000 mileage; 2) 60 days before today (e.g. 7 Aug 2026) · 301,000 mileage. (Low)
  8. Count every date back from the day you run the case; the date in brackets is only the example for a run on 6 Oct 2026. Seed and read on the same day, because an estimate and a reading's age both count days up to today.
  9. Seed each reading in the table, oldest first: open Work Orders and press New Work Order for the unit; type the reading's mileage in the work order's Mileage field (and its engine hours in Engine Hours where the table gives one; leave the field untouched where it does not) and save; expand the Maintenance schedule card, open the three-dot menu of a seed service not used yet, choose Mark complete, keep On a work order with this work order chosen, set Reset date to the reading's date and press Mark complete. That work order's values become readings dated the Reset date. Confirm any warning the field shows.
  10. When every reading is in: on the unit's Maintenance tab open the 'ZZAUTOTEST Reading seed' schedule's menu, choose Remove from schedule and confirm, so the seed services add no rows. Check the Mileage card's last recorded value and date match the table's last reading.
  11. Create unit 'ZZAUTOTEST 563' with no mileage at all and enroll it on 'ZZAUTOTEST Rate PM' with PM-M last done today.
  12. If Mark complete does not record a seeded reading (the Mileage or Engine Hours card does not show that value and date afterwards), stop: mark this case Blocked and write "seeding failed: Mark complete did not record the reading" in the result comment. That is a separate problem with its own case, not a failure of this one.
custom_steps:
1. Open units 560, 561 and 562 and read the confidence under PM-M's due month and on the Mileage card.
  2. Read how each reading itself is labelled (recorded or estimated).
  3. Open unit 563 and read PM-M's row and the Mileage card.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • 560 reads High, 561 Medium and 562 Low confidence: one of three grades for the estimate.
  • The readings themselves are labelled recorded or estimated, never Low, Medium or High.
  • 563 shows no confidence grade: it is in No data, the calendar governs PM-M and the row says the meter has no basis yet.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-3780 (Maintenance Reminders); story SV-10568 (S11, Rate, estimate and confidence); Chunk 2 MR (Confluence 897679389) as edited 5 October 2026, S11; read 6 Oct 2026. Source-verified 6 October 2026; not yet build-verified.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S11-R8: “Confidence will be one of Low, Medium, High. It grades an estimate, and is deliberately not the vocabulary used for a reading's own state in S9-R2”
  • S11-R17: “No data is a separate state, not a confidence level. It applies where there is nothing to estimate from, the calendar governs, and the row says the meter has no basis yet”
  • S18-R19: “Mark complete On a work order also records that work order's mileage and engine hours as the asset's readings, dated the Reset date”
